name: Listel
description: A listel — the narrow flat band that separates two mouldings, run as an open square.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 4; rotate: 45; scale: 0.99; frame: 6); clip-path: @shape(points: 4; rotate: 45; scale: 0.99; frame: 6); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 30%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 4; rotate: 45; frame: 12); clip-path: @shape(points: 4; rotate: 45; frame: 12); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
